headline: Strong growth; margins hurt by higher expenses

highlights: Per (%) -4/68/108 12M Avg Val (INR M) 312 Free float (%) 40.1 Financials & Valuations (INR b) Y/E MARCH FY26 FY27E FY28E Sales 50.2 65.1 74.0 EBITDA 4.6 6.6 8.3 EBITDA (%) 9.2 10.1 11.2 Adj.
EBITDA grew 41% YoY to INR1.7b, while EBITDA margin declined 25bp YoY to 9.5%, primarily due to higher operating expenses.
The company continues to benefit from strong order execution and capacity utilization, with further growth expected to be supported by capacity expansion across key geographies.

We expect PGIL to deliver healthy revenue growth, supported by volume growth and capacity additions, while improving operating leverage and product mix should support margin expansion over the medium term.

PGIL plans to invest INR6.75-7.25b over FY27-30 towards capacity expansion and backward integration into knitting and dyeing, targeting revenue of INR90-100b by FY30.

Valuation and view: Reiterate BUY We expect PGIL’s growth to be driven by ongoing capex additions across geographies, along with backward integration into knitting and dyeing, backed by strong top-five customer relationships.
